description: Update Your page fields (not the launch page: use launchpad_update). Arrays replace existing values. Publishing (published: true) needs the person's approval and confirm_publish: true. Without it, edits to a page that is already published are saved as a draft and the public page keeps its approved version. Automatic checks may hold changes for review; inspect pending_review, moderation_status and owner_reason before claiming publication. Requires a claimed handle; Free must show the badge. HTTPS destinations and contrast are enforced by the API. Requires API key scope: draft.

confirm_publish.description: true only after the person explicitly approved publishing; required whenever this call publishes.

sections.description: Story sections shown between the signup form and the links, in order. The FULL list: it replaces the saved one, so read page_get first and send every section to keep (with its id). Send [] to remove them all.

body.description: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line. No HTML, no markdown links.

id.description: Keep the id of an existing section; leave it out for a new one.

image_alt.description: Required with image_url: what the picture shows.

image_url.description: Optional picture. Must be an https://images.hollerpost.com URL (uploaded with email_image_upload or from the Hollerpost stock catalog).

url.description: The handle (like yourbusiness) or the full profile link. Saved as the full https link. WhatsApp takes the number with country code.

theme.description: The whole look. Send every field you want to keep: the theme replaces the saved one. A theme without accentColor, backgroundStyle, headingFont and layout keeps the classic look.

accentColor.description: Six-digit hex accent for background patterns and details.

backgroundStyle.description: Background behind the page. Text keeps 4.5:1 contrast against the pattern too (the API checks).

headingFont.description: Headline font. body means the same as fontFamily.

layout.description: centered, left aligned, or the page on a card over the background.

linkStyle.description: How the page links look. button: solid buttons (default). outline: outlined buttons. pill: round pills with an arrow. todo: to-do list rows with an empty box. checklist: rows with a ticked box. microchip: cyberpunk chips with notched corners. clouds: puffy cloud shapes. ticket: admission tickets with notched sides. Colors come from the theme; the main link and signup button stay solid.

motion.description: How much the page moves. lively (default): gentle entrance, button lift, signup shine, a small celebration on joining. subtle: soft fade and small hover lifts. off: no movement. Visitors who ask their device for reduced motion always get none.
